basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old living in Austin, Texas, currently exploring new experiences and overcoming personal challenges. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which lets me indulge in my passion for art and creativity. I'm pretty new to Reddit but have quickly found it to be a fascinating place for learning and connecting with people. I'm interested in alternative experiences and self-discovery, which led me to try LSD recently. I enjoy learning about new technologies and apps, and I also suffer from some driving anxiety, which I am working through. Typically, I'm online in the evenings, especially after work. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time watching sports, especially The Michael Kay Show.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design with a degree from a local art school. Much of what I know about psychedelics comes from online research and a few documentaries. I also have a keen interest in technology and apps, often trying out new ones to see how they might improve my workflow and daily life.
